Your focus will be on sourcing, supplier management, and contract administration throughout the entire supply chain.Your tasks:- You support procurement planning and the selection of suitable suppliers for galleys and catering equipment.- You assist in tendering activities, compare supplier proposals, and contribute to cost analyses to support sound commercial purchasing decisions.- You participate in contract negotiations and maintain contractual documentation while coordinating terms and conditions throughout the contract lifecycle.- In day-to-day operations, you manage supplier relationships and monitor performance, quality, logistics, and on-time delivery.- You work closely with internal departments, stakeholders, and multidisciplinary teams to align and consolidate requirements effectively.- Throughout development, serial production, and in-service support phases, you oversee suppliers, processes, and compliance with agreed contractual conditions.- You contribute to process improvement initiatives, helping to enhance efficiency within procurement and the supply chain.VORAUSSSETZUNGEN:- Completed bachelor's degree, for example in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or International Management.- Initial professional experience in procurement, supplier management, contract management, or within a supply chain or logistics environment.- Understanding of technical and functional interrelationships, as well as the ability and willingness to quickly analyze complex topics.- Structured, independent, and results-oriented way of working, with a focus on deadlines, quality, and business objectives.- Strong communication skills for collaborating with internal stakeholders and external partners.- Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word; initial experience with SAP and Google Workspace is advantageous.- Business-fluent English is required; German is considered an asset.- Working hours: Full-time position with 35 hours per week.Benefits:- An unlimited employment contract- 35-hour workweek- 30 days of annual leave- An annual salary of around 72.000 €- An attractive package following the Equal Pay model- Flexible handling of overtime through compensatory time-off or payment

jobs.occupation: Cabin Integration Engineer (d/f/m) AIRBUS (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description: We are seeking a Cabin Integration Engineer (d/f/m) in Finkenwerder for a full-time position within Airbus. This is an excellent opportunity for a configuration management specialist, cabin configuration manager, or aircraft customization coordinator who would like to contribute to cabin and cargo configuration topics as part of a transnational team.Your tasks:- Serve as the central contact for all cabin configuration-related matters across several ATA systems and ensure that aircraft configuration at modification level aligns with customer requests.- Assist with the configuration integration of late mandatory customer option requests and ensure customer definitions are delivered on schedule and with the required quality.- Ensure that the relevant EPAC/TDUs, product offers, bricks, and MOD build-ups are ready for the applicable Head of Version rebuilds and the related Custom Definition Freeze agenda.- Track the availability and quality of customization modifications in the Aircraft Configuration Control database and support dependable Request for Change coverage.- Prepare MOD build-ups for pre-development packages for larger projects and support project and chief engineering teams in reducing risks in new developments.- Help drive digitalisation, Lean opportunities, and process simplification to enhance configuration integration deliverables, rate adaptability, and customer satisfaction.- Collaborate closely with international stakeholders in Finkenwerder and contribute to the ongoing improvement of configuration processes, tools, and workflow efficiency.VORAUSSSETZUNGEN:- Degree in engineering, aerospace engineering, business informatics, or a comparable technical field, ideally at bachelor's level or above.- Early professional experience in configuration management, project management, process management, or a related aviation environment is an advantage.- Basic understanding of cabin design, customization processes, and change management is desirable.- Good IT skills, including MS Office and common collaboration tools; experience with ICC, Taksy/Gesy/Tesy, or Google Workspace.- Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a transnational team setting.- Open-minded approach, high motivation, and the confidence to question existing practices and contribute to improvements.- Ability to manage periods of high workload in a dynamic environment while remaining thorough and dependable.- Work Hours: Full-time, 35 hours per week.- Very good command of English is required, German at least at a good working level.Benefits:- An unlimited employment contract- 35-hour workweek- 30 days of annual leave- An annual salary of around 80.000 €- An attractive package following the Equal Pay model- Flexible handling of overtime through compensatory time-off or payment
